text:
jason-support: customer reported widespread fn-invoke failures after the v8 rollout to hosted-prod (org: acme-inc). They see tool invocation errors and 500s, also some auth 401s for a subset. https://support.example/ticket/10234 :ambulance:
priya-eng: thanks — can you paste a failing request + response? priority? :eyes:
jason-support: minimal repro: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/execute -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-cust-xxx' -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-model:v8.0.2\", \"input\": \"summarize:\", \"tool_call\": {\"name\": \"lookup_customer\", \"args\": {\"account\": 123}}}'
response: 500 {\"error\":\"tool_invocation_failed\", \"reason\":\"schema_validation_error: missing required field 'customer_id' for lookup_customer\"}
liam-sre: we also have a spike in 5xxs from runtime across rgn-us-west-2 starting ~3087654300, latency + tail spikes. Paging graphs: https://grafana/redwood/d/abc/runtime-5xx
emma-ops: confirmed billing alert for acme-org — they hit retries and got charged more. CFO flagged it. We need short-term mitigation for that org now.
andrew-ml: initial hunch: v8 changed tool selection policy -> now picks 'lookup_customer' variant that expects 'customer_id' instead of 'account'. Tool schema changed during model->tool binding. If model emits old arg name 'account', runtime validation fails.
priya-eng: can you dump the tool resolver output for a failing request? liam, can we correlate request IDs with resolver logs?
liam-sre: log snippet from runtime (trimmed):
```
[3087654312] request_id=req-3f2a tool_resolver=lookup_customer variant=v2 expected_schema={customer_id:int,...} input_args={account:123}
validation: FAILED -> missing customer_id
```
canarybot: Canary feedback summary: 43/120 tool-calls failed in canary cohort for v8.0.2 -> predominant failure: schema mismatch for lookup_customer, address_lookup. Confidence: high.
jason-support: customer says their integration didn't change and worked on v7.9.1 — started failing after canary expanded. They want rollback + credits.
priya-eng: immediate mitigations: 1) pin acme-inc to model v7.9.1 via routing override, 2) create temporary runtime fallback to previous tool schema for lookup_customer (if feasible), 3) rollback canary expansion. Which is fastest?
liam-sre: fastest = routing override + rollback canary expansion. Fallback code path needs eng-ml review and may take hours. I'll push routing override for org:acme-inc now.
emma-ops: doing override now, ETA 5m. Also opened billing adjustment ticket for acme-inc.
andrew-ml: root cause analysis plan: compare model->tool selector logic changes between v7 and v8, check schema registry diffs, reproduce locally with model v8 to see tool emission naming. I suspect the model prompt/template changed breaking arg names.
priya-eng: can we repro end-to-end in staging? jason, can you provide a sample API key we can use (or generate a test org) so we can run same calls without affecting customer?
jason-support: gave test key in ticket, use sk-test-acme. Also attached full failing payloads.
liam-sre: rollback canary to v7.9.1 for production canary cohort scheduled in 10m. Deploy-bot: submitted rollback job #3821 (canary->v7.9.1) :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: rollback job accepted, ETA ~8m, will notify when complete.
priya-eng: OK. Post-rollback run these checks: 1) run 50 synthetic tool invocations for lookup_customer 2) confirm 5xxs back to baseline 3) confirm no auth anomalies 4) verify billing spike stops. Assigning: andrew-ml (RCA), liam-sre (rollback + metrics), priya-eng (coord + customer comms), jason-support (customer updates).
andrew-ml: starting RCA now. Early note: model tokenizer changes shouldn't affect arg names, so likely a template/selector heuristic tweak. Will revert the selection change in the model shim if confirmed.
jason-support: I'll tell customer we pinned them and we are rolling back canary. Apologized and offered credit.
liam-sre: rollback completed at 3087654378 — metrics look good so far, 5xx rate down to baseline, toolcall success for synthetic runs: 98/100 (investigating the 2 flaps).
emma-ops: billing alert cleared for acme-inc, refund job queued.
priya-eng: next steps: andrew please post a short postmortem draft in #postmortems within 48h with RCA and mitigation to prevent model->tool schema drift. Also add unit test in tool resolver that rejects schema-incompatible model variants during canary.
andrew-ml: will do. Also propose gating model->tool selector with explicit schema-contract checks during rollouts.
jason-support: customer satisfied with immediate actions, will keep ticket open until PM confirms RCA. Thanks team :heart:
